body:
Adds `NewZealand::NZFMA`, which follows the NZFMA recommended holidays, updated earlier this year. Wellington and Auckland Anniversary Days are considered holidays through 2025 and business days from 2026 onward.

Please see https://swapsmonitor.com/%f0%9f%93%8c-new-zealand-business-day-nzbd-calendar-update/

review_comments.body:
These helpers are usually declared as `(Day d, Month m, Year y, Weekday w)` or similar to avoid recomputing date fields, which is a non-trivial computation.

You can apply this to `NewZealand::CommonImpl::isBusinessDay()` as well for the same reason (which is an improvement on the current code). To do so you'll have to rename it and drop `override`, so you can change the signature.

title: Add New Zealand NZFMA calendar
